question: Can LMS learners retrieve only course/version-approved evidence with independently verifiable UTF8 citations, missing-evidence abstention and visible curator-declared conflicts, reusing the canonical context bridge?
premises: Authenticated Actor and tenant/project provisioning are host-supplied.
Source snapshots are operator-provided and course-reviewed; URLs/hashes alone do not authenticate origin.
Lexical retrieval supplies evidence packets, not generated answers or general semantic entailment.
Conflict groups are explicit reviewed metadata, not automated contradiction discovery.

predictions.acceptance: Every returned quote resolves to exact pinned ArtifactRef/version and byte offsets/hash, even after latest source pointers change.
Other-course/tenant/unapproved sources are excluded before ranking or response-budget selection.
No relevant indexed evidence returns abstention; a hit in a declared conflict group exposes every required conflict reference or fails the budget explicitly.
Missing/tampered sources and forged citation bounds/text/digest fail rather than receiving evaluator credit.
Frozen synthetic dev/evaluation case IDs are disjoint, exact case/source hashes and failures are preserved, and results never change mastery/verification authority.

simplex.reason: Evidence identity is exact, not a weighted approval mixture.
simplex.invariant_or_test: No partial weight permits an unauthorized or altered citation.

n_ality.reason: Tenant, course/version, source/version, excerpt and declared conflict axes remain independently checked.
n_ality.invariant_or_test: A matching text snippet cannot substitute for source/version or course membership.

continuum.reason: No quantitative field approximation is needed in this discrete citation slice.
continuum.invariant_or_test: Offsets preserve original UTF8 bytes, with no interpolation.

fuzzy_logic.reason: Lexical ranks are heuristic orderings; future similarity/membership needs separate evaluation.
fuzzy_logic.invariant_or_test: Ranks/memberships cannot override permission, integrity, abstention or review gates.

bias_checks.trigger: Same team writes reader and synthetic cases
bias_checks.countermeasure: Freeze case/source gold before observing reader outcomes; independent citation verification and source review; disclose public/non-blind fixture limits.

bias_checks.trigger: Scores may hide missing cases or omitted conflicting sources
bias_checks.countermeasure: Record expected totals, exact failed-case outcomes, source identities, exclusions and response budgets.

scope: Code plus original synthetic fixture sources only; no private corpus/student records or external fetch/execution.
stopping_rule: Local negatives and independent review, then pinned unprivileged OCI run. Preserve failures; revise code/fixture versions explicitly rather than hiding unsuccessful cases.
